standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme-level limit preservation characterization
standard_prerequisites.use: U(T) = colim U(T_i), R(T) = colim R(T_i); and the converse for schemes.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification preserves limit preservation
standard_prerequisites.use: Passes from the presheaf W |-> U(W)/R(W) to X = U/R.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limit preservation under base change and composition
standard_prerequisites.use: Propagates limit preservation along the etale covers in direction (2).

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale maps are locally of finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-etale-locally-finite-presentation (cross-chapter, cited at ~747-749)
standard_prerequisites.use: U -> V x_Y X is locally of finite presentation.

core_obligations: (1)⇒(2)：化归到 X lfp over S；表出 X=U/R（spaces-definition-presentation）；Morphisms of Spaces 定义给 U、R 皆 lfp over S ⇒ limits-proposition-characterize-locally-finite-presentation 给 U(T)=colim U(T_i)、R(T)=colim R(T_i)；预层 W↦U(W)/R(W) 保极限 ⇒ sheafify-finite-presentation 引理给层化 X=U/R 保极限（~709-738 行）。

(2)⇒(1)：取 V→Y、U→V×_Y X 满射 etale；base-change 引理给 V×_Y X→V 保极限；etale-locally-finite-presentation 引理给 U→V×_Y X lfp ⇒ 由 (1) 方向保极限；composition 引理给复合 U→V 保极限 ⇒ limits 命题（scheme 版）给 U→V lfp，即 (1)（~741-758 行）。

集合论附注（完整论证）：limits 命题要求对『所有』定向逆系，而现设定仅 (Sch/S)_fppf 对象；检查该命题 (2)⇒(1) 的证明化归到 U、V 仿射；U=Spec(A)、V=Spec(B) 时基数 ≤|B| 的环的谱皆同构于 (Sch/S)_fppf 对象；algebra-lemma-characterize-finite-presentation 的 only if 部分只用基数 ≤|B| 的 A-代数 ⇒ 足够（~760-780 行）。
